title: A node renaming popup spawns in Scene dock when multiple nodes get selected with Shift
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: v4.7.2.stable.official [ed1daf0bf], v4.8.dev.custom_build [36a2dd027].

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev (36a2dd027) - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor (1920x1080 @ 144.00 Hz) - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Ti Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.16.1074) - AMD Ryzen 5 5600H with Radeon Graphics (12 threads) - 15.34 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When you have multiple nodes selected by holding Shift, the first node will open its node renaming popup if you click it the second time while still holding Shift.

In this video I select the nodes while holding Shift and then click on them while still holding Shift. You can see that only the first node in the selection opens its node renaming popup and the other nodes do not.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d2903951-1a0a-448f-8b52-5cd87d934521

This does not appear to be dependent on the selection order because it's only the first node in the selection that activates the node renaming popup.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Select the first node
2. While holding Shift select another node
3. Click on the first node in the selection while still holding Shift (also opens while you don't hold Shift)

N/A
